notes.title: v1.2.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Leaderboards display 14 at a time now, and use "..." when names are too long
[*] Fixed cursor appearing over itself outside of screen
[*] Fixed hearts not spawning
[*] Bat ball moves slightly slower
[*] Bat balls don't appear until Wave 12, and nervous porcupine shows up earlier instead
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.1 - Polish and Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Yo! I hope you're all enjoying the game, here are some small fixes and polish in the new update:[/p][p][/p][p][b]v1.2.1 Patch Notes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed co-op achievements happening during single player gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]When the boss spawns, players all get fully restored health[/p][/*][*][p]Triple and big shot powerups increased lasting time (10s -> 12s)[/p][/*][*][p]Invincibility powerup increased lasting time (12s -> 15s)[/p][/*][*][p]Made all powerups drop more often, and now drop more often when there's less players alive/playing[/p][/*][*][p]Polished stats menu UI arrangement[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Unidentified Feline Obliterators Demo in Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Unidentified Feline Obliterators is coming to Steam, and is in the Steam Next Fest from February 24th to March 3rd.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507619/f4cc798151f3405ce009970b67a75807c3c98e6a.png[/img]

There's also a demo for the game during this time, so try it out, pet a cat, and wishlist the game!
